description: Defines the 'measurement_procedure' class for handling measurement procedures in 3GPP NR-RAN context, including creation of measurement responses and failures, context management, and communication with CU-CP.

classes.name: measurement_procedure
classes.description: Handles the measurement procedure for positioning in NR-RAN, including request handling, response creation, and communication with network components.

methods.name: measurement_procedure
methods.description: Constructor initializing the measurement procedure with context and configuration parameters.

methods.name: create_measurement_failure
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 measurement failure PDU based on cause.

methods.name: create_measurement_context
methods.description: Creates measurement context for the request.

methods.name: prepare_du_measurement_information_requests
methods.description: Prepares measurement info requests for DUs.

methods.name: handle_du_measurement_information_outcome
methods.description: Handles outcome of DU measurement info.

methods.name: send_ul_nrppa_pdu
methods.description: Sends measurement outcome PDU to CU-CP.
